welcome_message:
Welcome to agent-factory: a Databricks Declarative Automation Bundle that turns a small domain.yml file into a deployed, evaluated Genie + RAG agent pair.

This scaffolds a copy of the whole repository, including the f1 example domain (kept as a working reference) and an empty folder for your own domain. See docs/DESIGN.md section 3 for the domain.yml contract, and README.md for the quickstart.

project_name.description: Directory name for the new project
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Name must consist of letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.

domain_name.description: Name for your own domain (creates an empty domains/<name>/ folder to fill in; f1 stays as a working example)
domain_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Must match factory/schema.py's Domain.name pattern: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.

success_message:
Your project is ready in '{{.project_name}}'.

Next steps:
  cd {{.project_name}}
  uv sync
  databricks auth login --host <your-workspace-url> --profile {{.project_name}}-dev
  # Create a Unity Catalog catalog via the UI first if needed (see resources/core/shared.yml)
  databricks bundle deploy -t dev -p {{.project_name}}-dev
  databricks bundle run -t dev ingest_f1 -p {{.project_name}}-dev

Then fill in domains/{{.domain_name}}/domain.yml with your own domain's tables and documents, per docs/DESIGN.md section 3, and repeat the deploy/ingest steps for it.
